content: You've been wanting to make an Axe out of these Elemetal ingots for a while now, and seeing how dirt, sand and stone were easily cleared with Earth Elemetal tools, you thought they would also do the trick for trees
Weirdly enough you needed Air Elemetal to manage that, maybe because the trees grow up into the sky? Who knows.
But now that figured out the correct materials, you can use this axe to instantly chop down trees
You built in some additional safety features to prevent your wooden house from vanishing if you cut down the wrong block by accident.
There also seems to be a limit to the size of the trees you instantly chop down, but as long as they aren't giant world trees, it should work just fine.
